offers.description:
At bunq, we’re on a mission to Make Life Easy for our users by creating the most user-centric banking experience out there. That starts with keeping their data safe. As AI makes attackers faster, we’re seeing more critical zero-day vulnerabilities than ever, and we need to stay ahead of them.

That’s where you come in. As our Security Engineer, you’ll own how 700 colleagues get secure access to our systems, and you’ll help defend bunq against attacks as they happen. You’ll design and build security processes that AI can’t run on its own, and automate everything that it can.

Take Ownership 🚀

You’ll keep bunq secure, from access control to incident response. Here’s how you’ll do it:

  • Own access control governance in Okta Identity Governance, automating how access is granted, revoked and reviewed, so every employee and contractor has the right access from day one.

  • Investigate and triage security incidents and vulnerability findings, decide whether they’re malicious, and escalate or fix them fast.

  • Drive the replacement of our security monitoring system with an AI-based platform that detects and stops threats automatically, and build automations so the team can focus on real security issues.

offers.description:
Our users trust bunq to keep their money safe. That means spotting, reporting, and preventing bad actors before they can do harm. Your challenge in this mission is to strengthen our reporting operations, and ensure that we meet local laws and regulations — helping us keep Making Life Easy for our users 🚀

Up for it? Kick off your application by taking our assessment and find out if bunq is your perfect match!

Take ownership

Your mission is to protect our users by making sure suspicious activity is flagged and reported in line with legal and regulatory requirements 🔎 As our Reporting Agent in User Quality, you will:

  1. Ensure compliance by reporting suspicious activity to the appropriate FIUs and implementing country-specific financial crime reporting requirements.

  2. Establish clear procedures and continuously improve reporting processes through gap analysis and automation to enhance scalability, accuracy, and regulatory alignment.

  3. Monitor reporting performance using analytics tools like Retool, Looker, and GSheets, while managing all open CAP items within required deadlines.

offers.description:
Keeping users money and data safe is the job. As our Security Lead, you take end-to-end responsibility for security at bunq. AI is changing the game: attackers find holes and write exploits faster than ever, so we need to rethink how we protect ourselves, and we need AI to fight AI threats. You will be the architect of that new way of working, and you will build it hands-on, together with a team of 3 security engineers.

This is an operational, technical role. The policy, compliance and audit work (including ISO27001 and PCI-DSS) sits with our Information Security Officer, so you can spend your time on real security improvements.

Take Ownership:

In your first 6 months, you will:

  • Lead and coach 3 security engineers.

  • Rethink how bunq protects itself against new, AI-driven threats.

  • Simplify our infrastructure to reduce the attack surface.

  • Implement better segmentation, monitoring and multiple layers of defense.

  • Oversee security vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response and security awareness.

  • Make sure all systems are patched within SLA, and never lower the quality bar.
